prompt:
You are a meta-review agent for a coding-agent AI co-scientist.
Objective: Find the single appended system-prompt instruction that most improves a small headless coding agent's held-out-test pass rate on short self-contained Python implementation tasks whose prompts do not themselves instruct testing or verification. Hypotheses must be A/B-testable (baseline: no appended instruction; candidate: baseline plus exactly one instruction) and grounded in observed small-model failure modes: incomplete extraction of listed requirements, unverified edge cases, and premature completion. The agent under test already writes and runs its own ad-hoc tests when it chooses to; an intervention must add value beyond that default behavior.
Preferences: aligned with the research objective; plausible from code, benchmark, or literature evidence; novel or a novel combination of known techniques; testable with a concrete experiment; safe and auditable
Constraints: do not autonomously modify source code; do not claim measured improvement without benchmark evidence
Metrics: pass_rate; regression_count; tool_calls; wall_time; cost
Safety notes: human review required before applying code changes

- rev-cf839ae4553b llm_full_review hyp-1e68a83c8e43: accept; weaknesses=Confounds two changes relative to baseline: writing tests AND reordering work; a null result cannot say which half failed; Requires the trial environment to support test execution smoothly; friction there penalizes this arm disproportionately; Turn consumption is the highest of the family, interacting with the trial turn cap as an artificial ceiling
- rev-b6820f7c141b llm_deep_verification hyp-1e68a83c8e43: accept; weaknesses=Two linked fundamental assumptions (test correctness, test fidelity) are uncertain and share a failure mode; Confounds artifact-writing with work reordering; a null result cannot be attributed; Highest turn consumption of the family interacts with the registered turn cap
- rev-c61aff8cd08f llm_simulation_review hyp-1e68a83c8e43: accept; weaknesses=Simulated worst case is credible: 6-8 turns consumed writing tests leaves too few to finish implementation on dense tasks, flipping a baseline pass into a candidate fail (negative delta via overhead alone); On sparse tasks the simulation collapses to baseline behavior plus dead-weight turns
- rev-a35f944d84b2 llm_initial_review hyp-6208299229f5: accept; weaknesses=Assumes baseline failures concentrate in edge classes; if omissions are of whole requirements rather than edge handling, the redirect buys little; A fixed category list can anchor the agent and crowd out task-specific adversarial thinking; Delta shrinks on tasks where the agent's default testing already covers boundaries, adding variance across tasks
- rev-1c3b38c5bc54 llm_full_review hyp-6208299229f5: accept; weaknesses=The category list is a hypothesis about where graders discriminate; a mismatch (e.g., graders testing interacting flags, not boundaries) nullifies the redirect; Anchoring risk: enumerating the given six categories may substitute for thinking about the task's own unusual cases; Per-category execution could be performed shallowly (one trivial input per category) satisfying the letter of the instruction without its intent
- rev-6b2d287235cf llm_deep_verification hyp-6208299229f5: accept; weaknesses=The decisive premise (baseline failures concentrate in edge classes) stays unmeasured until baseline arms run on a de-saturated suite; Effect dilutes on tasks whose graders discriminate via requirement interactions rather than input classes
- rev-530a131423cd llm_simulation_review hyp-6208299229f5: accept; weaknesses=Simulated miss: a task whose grader discriminates on a never-implemented requirement — categorized edge checks all pass and the trial still fails; the intervention is inert on omission-type failures; Shallow-compliance path (one trivial input per category) satisfies the instruction with near-zero effect
- rev-c04856754956 llm_initial_review hyp-a473177a6b6c: accept; weaknesses=Two-phase compliance risk: the agent may write the checklist and never perform the final per-item verification pass; Extraction quality bounds the mechanism: a checklist that misses a clause reproduces the baseline failure with extra steps; Moderate turn overhead on spec-dense tasks, though less than test-first since items are prose, not executable code
- rev-10dfc84efcaf llm_full_review hyp-a473177a6b6c: accept; weaknesses=The verification half of the instruction is the part small models most plausibly skip under completion pressure; the artifact alone does not guarantee the check; Extraction fidelity is bounded by the same reader that fails at baseline — items can be paraphrased in ways that drop the discriminating detail (boundary direction, tie order); Benefit should scale with requirement density; on sparse tasks it degenerates to overhead, adding cross-task variance to the estimate
- rev-fc8eb988306d llm_deep_verification hyp-a473177a6b6c: accept; weaknesses=Compliance-depth and baseline-failure-profile uncertainties are shared with the whole family and only resolvable by running the experiment; Effect size should scale with requirement density, adding cross-task variance on mixed suites
- rev-bec52b1cbba8 llm_simulation_review hyp-a473177a6b6c: accept; weaknesses=Simulated compliance-decay path: checklist written, implementation runs long, final verification pass skipped under completion pressure — artifact present, effect absent; Simulated paraphrase path: item 7 recorded as 'handle ties' without the stated tie-break direction; self-check passes, grader fails — extraction happened, discrimination lost; On a 5-requirement task the simulation degenerates to baseline plus a formality, diluting the pooled estimate
